comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus unlatch, withdraw, support, and place a plug-in protective relay.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires small-tool rotary adjustment; record lifts a latch handle, extracts a connector-loaded unit, transfers its weight to the second hand, and places it upright.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two qualified carriage stops and a retained setting; record requires the correct labelled relay fully removed and resting upright on a mat without touching the other relay or reaching into the case.
comparison.reason: Loaded extraction and weight-transfer coordination are materially different from shock-response tuning. Candidate response thresholds are partly undeclared.
